scope: Source audit of the pinned ZealOS hash removal path and ARM64 bootstrap, not a guest runtime test.
observations: Pinned Kernel/KHashA.ZC HashRemDel finds a matching instance in a single table, checks pointer identity, unlinks it, and calls HashDel.
Pinned Kernel/KHashB.ZC HashDel handles additional allocations depending on entry type, including source symbols, define data, and dictionary words.

Before the targeted follow-up, bootstrap FramePtrDel invalidated a matching entry and deferred reclamation until task teardown. A FramePtr-specific removal path now unlinks and frees local generic entries; the full HashRemDel implementation is still not present.

The vendored Aiwnios HashRemDel previously deleted by name and re-added the supplied pointer. Its native table unlinking now checks the local instance and pointer identity; no live guest caller has been established.

frameptr_followup.evidence: The focused terminal test verified that an older duplicate cannot be removed as instance one, that FramePtrDel on a child task leaves an inherited parent entry intact, and that local duplicates are removed in order. LastClass and terminal recovery passed; a separate HomeSys startup and task cleanup run passed.

type_mask_retest.evidence: A newer same-name entry matching a second type bit blocked removal of the FramePtr entry, preserving both until the blocker was removed. The original LastClass demo and terminal recovery also passed.

frameptr_followup.scope: FramePtr generic entries in the tested QEMU cases only; arbitrary hash entry types and live UTM/Pi are not verified.

remaining: Exercise general guest hash removal on isolated tables with duplicate names, types, instance and pointer-identity mismatches, and type-specific cleanup; implement the complete guest behavior before claiming full-kernel parity.

native_followup.scope: Host-compiled native generic entries and table unlinking; does not establish general guest HashRemDel or type-specific HashDel cleanup. The AArch64 kernel hash is unchanged because the routine is currently removed by linker garbage collection.
